title: [repo cleanup] delete all RHEL branches from upstream
body: Since RHEL branch maintenance has switched to a fork for sometime now, I propose we delete all branches with `-rhel` in the name from here.

comments.body:
@cevich any concerns RE: fork syncing?

@podman-container-tools/podman-maintainers PTAL

Have all internal builds been moved to the internal repo?

I don't have any strong opinion about this, I am fine keeping the old ones for historical purposes around but I guess it also makes sense to drop them to avoid any confusion and to remove the "rhel" name from the CNCF repo.

> Have all internal builds been moved to the internal repo?

AFAIK, yes. @cevich @jnovy @TomSweeneyRedHat can you confirm?

> I don't have any strong opinion about this, I am fine keeping the old ones for historical purposes around but I guess it also makes sense to drop them to avoid any confusion and to remove the "rhel" name from the CNCF repo.

Same here; it’s _hypothetically possible_ that those branches have external consumers, or that someone has a link to a commit on such a branch; OTOH removing them makes for a cleaner picture going forward. (With my RH hat on, I assume we are very sure we do have internal copies an nothing would be lost?)
